Yes. Hansen mapped approximately **81.3 hectares** of tree-cover loss within the property in 2021, equivalent to **2.23%** of its area. A further 37.3 hectares were mapped in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and were not counted as events.

Of the 81.3 hectares, 68.1 hectares were mapped as planted forest. Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation, land-use change or the cause of the loss.
